# Virtual Test Suite: shadow-root-namespace-check

This virtual test suite runs with the `ShadowRootNamespaceCheck` Blink feature
enabled, which enforces the DOM spec requirement that `attachShadow()` must
reject elements whose namespace is not the HTML namespace.
